wholePhysicalScope: The independently named mapped outline places and orients the ruins. The 1965–66 German Archaeological Institute survey fixes stylobate sides to 37.233/37.167 m and 19.512/19.526 m. The survey plan is aligned to the midpoint of the approximately 38.8 by 14.0 m mapped extent.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the five restored columns, low cella and stepped stylobate. Near levels add fluted drums, broken volutes and loose marble.
limitations: The mapped 14.0 m ruin width is narrower than the surveyed 19.52 m stylobate. Greater width comes from the architectural measurement, with its center relative to mapped remnants approximate.

The exact five column centerpoints within the northern row, individual fragment positions, cellular wall remnants and modern visitor-ground details require interpretation. The southern temenos walls, altar and Propylon are outside the temple model.
The public elevation is preserved, but coarse source terrain cannot resolve individual stones or the original stepped paving.
